5 Dumbbell Curl Variations for Biceps & Forearms

A targeted arm workout focusing on full biceps and forearm development through varying grip angles and arm positions. Perform 10-15 reps for 3-4 sets per exercise with 45-60 seconds of rest between sets.

15–20 min

Exercise Flow

Check off each exercise as you complete sets. Rest timer at the bottom.
01

Seated Standard-Grip Dumbbell Curl

3–4 sets × 10–15 reps
Biceps Brachii (Overall)
  • Keep palms facing forward (supinated) throughout the curl.
  • Keep elbows pinned close to your torso without swinging.

Why: Engages both the long and short heads balanced across the overall biceps.

02

Seated Neutral-Grip Dumbbell Curl

3–4 sets × 10–15 reps
Biceps Long HeadBrachialis
  • Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other (hammer grip).
  • Lock elbows at your side and squeeze at the peak of contraction.

Why: Targets the biceps long head and brachialis to build arm thickness and peak.

03

Seated Wide-Stance Dumbbell Curl

3–4 sets × 10–15 reps
Biceps Short Head
  • Flare arms outward at a slight angle away from the body.
  • Maintain supinated palms while curling upward along the wide line.

Why: Emphasizes the inner short head of the biceps for upper arm width.

04

Seated Reverse-Grip Dumbbell Curl

3–4 sets × 10–15 reps
BrachioradialisBrachialisForearms
  • Grip dumbbells with palms facing down (pronated grip).
  • Keep wrists firm and straight without bending backward.

Why: Develops forearm strength and strengthens the brachioradialis muscle.

05

Seated Two-Arm Close-Grip Dumbbell Curl

3–4 sets × 10–15 reps
Biceps Long HeadBrachialis
  • Press dumbbells close together or hold a single weight closely.
  • Keep hands centered in front of the chest while curling up smoothly.

Why: Provides concentrated tension on the outer biceps long head and brachialis.

Trainer Tips

  • Control the lowering (eccentric) phase of each rep for maximum hypertrophy.
  • Avoid swinging your shoulders or using momentum to lift the weights.
  • Rest 45–60 seconds between sets to maintain high intensity and pump.
